Game Overview

In The Wyoming Incident 3D, the core idea is straightforward: get lost in a TV's eerie world where ghostly heads lurk. Navigate a maze as you fend off specters with your arsenal. Survive the haunting puzzles to escape, but beware—the challenge intensifies without a trusty shotgun. Can you unlock the chilling secret ending?
